assets.label: workshop hoists and press
assets.service: heavy vehicle component removal and pressing

control_failures.control_label: exclusion of people from beneath elevated work
mechanical support of a load during maintenance access

hazard_media: stored potential of an elevated component
facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: unplanned release of gravity energy at HO-9403

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control DROP_ZONE_EXCLUSION: the exclusion of people from beneath elevated work had been bypassed, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an individual or team action.
Control LOAD_SUPPORT_FOR_MAINTENANCE: the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access on HO-9403 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining lifting appliances, specifically supporting a load for maintenance access. HO-9403 (workshop hoists and press) is in service for heavy vehicle component removal and pressing. The task proceeded during transfer operations while the exclusion of people from beneath elevated work had been bypassed. The gravity energy involved is held as suspended load, and the recorded presentation was fall, collapse, crush.
response.summary: On 23 April 2021 a potential incident was recorded on HO-9403 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during transfer operations; gravity energy held as suspended load was not released.
